description: UK rental listings from OpenRent (landlord-direct) for a city or area: listing ID and URL, monthly rent (GBP), bedrooms, bathrooms, studio/shared flags, furnished, bills included, pets, students and families accepted, garden, parking, minimum tenancy (months), days until available, first-listed date and coordinates. Filter by max rent, min bedrooms, furnished or pets; newest first. Also returns the total live listing count. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

area.description: City or area slug as in OpenRent URLs, e.g. london, manchester, bristol (required)

maxRent.description: Maximum rent per month in GBP

pets.description: true to list only pet-friendly lets
